note: Synthetic rehearsal mapping of third-party alert levels to watch/candidate, not calibrated. A GDACS alert or Google flood status is a third-party reference, not an AEGIS assessment, official warning or accuracy claim.

gdacs_alert.label: GDACS event
gdacs_alert.rationale: GDACS automatic alert level for an event inside the India bounding box; orange is a watch, red a candidate.

flood_gauge.label: Flood gauge forecast
flood_gauge.unit: severity (0 no flooding, 1 above normal, 2 severe, 3 extreme)
flood_gauge.rationale: Google Flood Forecasting latest gauge status near the Hyderabad pilot grid; model forecast, not a gauge observation.
